## Classes and results

Teachers with a Teacher plan can make a class on LessonCraftStudio, give its children worksheets to do on a screen, and see how each child did. This section explains what that feature stores. If you use the site without a class link, this section does not apply; the rest of this policy describes what the site does for every visitor.

### Who is responsible

The school decides whether this feature is used and for which children. Where a teacher works in a school, the school (or the authority that runs it) is the "controller" of the class data, and the teacher uses the feature on its behalf. A private tutor or a home-educating parent is the controller herself. We run the feature for them and follow their instructions; in data-protection terms we are their "processor", under the [data processing terms for classes](/class-terms), which apply to every class and which a school can have countersigned. For two things we are responsible ourselves: delivering the pages safely (which uses the device's internet address for the moment of the request) and the teacher's own account.

### What we store about a child

- **No name.** A class works with numbers: each child has a seat number and a picture of an animal. The teacher keeps the list of who has which number; we never receive it.
- **Results**: for each worksheet a child does through the class link: which worksheet it was, when it was opened, how many answers were right when the child first pressed Check and when that was, how many answers there were, which ones were right, how many times Check was pressed, and whether the page was finished. For a set with levels we also store which level the page was.
- **The class**: the name the teacher gave it and its language. The class name is shown on the class page, so a teacher should not put a person's name in it.

That is all. We do not ask for or store a surname, a date of birth, an email address, a photo, an address or a location. We do not store what a child typed or drew, only whether an answer was right. No timer runs, and nobody is shown how long a child took.

### How it works for a child

A child opens the class link, taps their own number and picture and does the worksheet. No account, no password, nothing to install. The child sees no score, no ranking and no timer. The class page is shared: a child who taps another seat sees which worksheets that seat has already done (done or not done, never how many were right).

The class page shows the seats of the whole class (numbers and pictures) so that each child can find their own. Anyone who has the class link can open that page, so a teacher should share the link only with the class. The link contains a long random key, and the teacher can replace it at any time, which switches the old link off.

### Who can see results

On the site, only the teacher who made the class can see results, when signed in. We do not show results to other teachers, to other customers or to the public, and there is no page for parents. We ourselves do not look at class data; we can reach the database only to run and repair the service. A parent who wants to see what is stored about their child asks the teacher or the school.

### What we use the data for

Only to show teachers the results of their own classes. We do not use class data for advertising, we do not sell it, we do not share it with anyone except the two companies that host and deliver the site (below), and we do not use it to train any system. We build no profile of a child for any purpose of our own. One thing is automatic and is part of the teaching: in a set with levels, the next page is easier or harder depending on how the last one went, and the teacher's screen sorts each result into "almost all right", "some wrong" or "many wrong". No decision about a child is made by the site.

### Cookies and tracking

On the class page and on every page a child opens from it, nothing is loaded from another company, no analytics runs and no advertising tag is present. The requests these pages send carry no cookie and set none. So that a child comes back to their own list, the browser tab remembers the tapped seat for 20 minutes, on the device only. Like every web server, ours receives the device's internet address with each request; for the class page and the requests behind it we do not write that address into our log. Our general log of requests (internet address, time, page address) is kept for security and deleted after 14 days.

### How long we keep it

- The teacher can delete one child's results, one child, or the whole class at any time. Deletion is immediate in our database.
- A class that has not been used for 14 months is deleted automatically.
- Every single result is deleted at the latest 14 months after it was made, even if the class is still in use. A page a child opened and never checked is removed after 7 days.
- If the teacher's plan ends, their classes are deleted 60 days later. The teacher can still read and delete them during those 60 days.
- Deleted data disappears from our backups within 7 days.

### Where it is

In one database on a server we rent from Hetzner Online GmbH (Germany), located in Finland. Backups that contain class data are kept on that server only. Cloudflare, Inc. (United States) delivers the site: every request, including a result, passes through its network and is not stored by it beyond short technical logs. Cloudflare is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework, and our contract with it contains the EU standard contractual clauses. These two companies are the only ones that handle class data.

### Your rights

Parents and children have the right to see what is stored, to have it corrected or deleted, to have its use restricted and to object to it. Because the school is responsible for the class and only the teacher knows which seat is which child, please ask the teacher or the school first; we help them answer. You can also write to us at support@lessoncraftstudio.com; we pass the request to the teacher without delay. You can complain to the data-protection authority of your country at any time. Accounts on LessonCraftStudio are for adults (18 or older); children never make an account.

### United States

Riza Kunur Genc (LessonCraftStudio), Björkvägen 15D, 459 31 Ljungskile, Sweden, support@lessoncraftstudio.com, operates this feature and is the only operator that collects information through it. We provide it to schools and teachers for school purposes only. From a child's device we receive the results listed above and, with each request, the device's internet address. We use that address only to deliver the page and to keep the service secure; we do not use it to contact a child, to recognize a child on other sites, to build a profile or to show advertising, and we do not keep it with the results. We never sell student information, never use it for targeted advertising and never use it for a commercial purpose unrelated to the school's use. We keep results no longer than stated under "How long we keep it" and then delete them. A school or teacher can review and delete a child's results at any time and can stop further collection by removing the seat; a parent asks the school, or writes to us and we pass the request on. For a school we act as a "school official" under FERPA, and we sign a district's student data privacy agreement on request.

### If something goes wrong

If class data is lost or seen by someone who should not see it, we tell the teacher and the school without delay and no later than 48 hours after we learn of it.

### Changes

We tell teachers by e-mail before we change what this feature stores or which companies handle it.

# Data processing terms for classes (classes and results)

**Between**

the school or school authority named at acceptance, represented by a person authorized to sign for it, or a private tutor or home educator who decides alone about the data ("the School", the controller), and

Riza Kunur Genc (LessonCraftStudio), Björkvägen 15D, 459 31 Ljungskile, Sweden, who operates LessonCraftStudio as a private person ("LessonCraftStudio", the processor).

## 1. Subject and duration

LessonCraftStudio provides the "classes and results" feature of its website to the School's teachers. This agreement applies for as long as a teacher of the School uses that feature, and until the data has been deleted under section 9. For classes that work with numbers only, these terms apply from the moment a teacher makes a class; a school can have them countersigned at any time.

## 2. Nature and purpose of the processing

Storing the classes a teacher makes, receiving the results of worksheets that children do through a class link, and showing those results to that teacher. The purpose is teaching: letting a teacher see what each child has understood. No other purpose.

## 3. Types of personal data

- Of children: a seat number and a picture; a display name (first name or nickname) only if the School has switched first names on; per worksheet: which worksheet, when it was opened, the number of right answers at the first Check and when that was, the number of answers, which answers were right, the number of Check presses, whether the page was finished; for a set with levels, the level of the page. Of the class: its name and language. In transit only, not stored with any of the above: the internet address of the device.
- Of teachers: the account data described in the general privacy policy.

No special categories of data are requested. The School instructs its teachers not to enter a child's name or other personal details in the class name, and, where first names are switched on, to enter nothing other than a first name or nickname as a display name.

## 4. Data subjects

Children in the School's classes, typically 4 to 10 years old. The School's teachers.

## 5. Instructions

LessonCraftStudio processes the data only on the School's documented instructions. The School gives its instructions by using the feature: making, changing and deleting classes, seats and assignments. LessonCraftStudio tells the School if it believes an instruction breaks data-protection law. These terms and the settings of the feature are the School's complete instructions. LessonCraftStudio does not process class data for purposes of its own and does not transfer it outside the European Economic Area except as described in section 14, unless Union or Member State law requires it; in that case it informs the School first, unless that law forbids it.

## 6. Confidentiality

Everyone at LessonCraftStudio who can access the data is bound to confidentiality. Access is limited to what is needed to run and repair the service.

## 7. Security

LessonCraftStudio keeps at least these measures:

- Transport encryption (HTTPS) for every page and request.
- Results can be read only by the teacher who owns the class, after signing in; every request is checked against the owner on the server.
- A class link contains a random key of 10 characters from 32 symbols; the teacher can replace it at any time. A result is tied to a seat by a random one-time token of 20 characters.
- A child's result request carries no cookie; no device identification is stored.
- The database is on a single server in Finland, reachable for administration only with a personal key. Backups of the database are kept on that server for 7 days; a copy that leaves the server holds no class data.
- Pages a child opens through a class link load nothing from other companies and run no analytics.
- Requests of the class page are logged without the device's internet address.
- The software that enforces these rules is covered by automated tests that are run before every release.

## 8. Sub-processors

The School agrees to these sub-processors:

| Sub-processor | Purpose | Place |
|---|---|---|
| Hetzner Online GmbH (Germany) | Server hosting | Finland, EU |
| Cloudflare, Inc. | Delivery of the website; requests pass through, class data is not stored | United States and its worldwide network; EU-US Data Privacy Framework certification of Cloudflare, Inc., and the EU standard contractual clauses (Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914) in Cloudflare's data processing addendum |

LessonCraftStudio informs the School 30 days before adding or replacing a sub-processor, by e-mail to the account address of each teacher of the School and on the page www.lessoncraftstudio.com/en/class-terms. LessonCraftStudio binds every sub-processor by contract to the same data-protection duties as in this agreement and remains fully liable to the School for what a sub-processor does. The School may object; if the objection cannot be met, the School may stop using the feature and its data is deleted.

## 9. Deletion and return

- A teacher can delete a child's results, a child, an assignment or a class at any time, and can print the results or save them as a PDF from the dashboard before doing so.
- A class not used for 14 months is deleted automatically. When the teacher's plan ends, their classes are deleted 60 days later.
- Every single result is deleted at the latest 14 months after it was made. A page a child opened and never checked is removed after 7 days.
- When this agreement ends, all class data is deleted within 60 days, and from backups within a further 7 days, unless a law requires it to be kept.

## 10. Helping the School

LessonCraftStudio helps the School answer requests from children and parents (access, correction, deletion, objection), with data-protection impact assessments, and in consultations with the supervisory authority, as far as the feature is concerned. Most requests can be met by the teacher directly in the feature. Requests that reach LessonCraftStudio are passed to the teacher without delay. LessonCraftStudio does not answer such requests itself. It also helps the School meet its duties on security, breach notification and impact assessment (GDPR Articles 32 to 36).

## 11. Personal data breaches

LessonCraftStudio tells the School without undue delay, and no later than 48 hours after becoming aware of it, of a breach that affects class data. The notice says what happened, which kinds of data and roughly how many children and records are affected, the likely consequences, what has been done, and whom to contact.

## 12. Audits

LessonCraftStudio gives the School the information needed to show that this agreement is kept, and allows an audit by the School or an auditor it names, with reasonable notice, at most once a year unless there is a concrete reason.

## 13. No other use

LessonCraftStudio does not use class data for advertising of any kind, does not sell or rent it, does not use it to train any system, does not combine it with other data, and builds no profile of a child except what the feature shows the teacher for teaching (the result bands and the automatic choice of the next page in a set with levels). Statistics that contain no names and no results of single children are not personal data and are outside this agreement.

## 14. Transfers outside the EU / EEA

Class data is stored in Finland. It passes through the network of Cloudflare, Inc., which may process it in the United States; this transfer rests on Cloudflare's certification under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and, should that fall away, on the EU standard contractual clauses in Cloudflare's data processing addendum.

## 15. Law and precedence

Where the School is in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom or Switzerland, this agreement is governed by the law of the School's country and the courts at the School's seat decide. Otherwise it is governed by the law of Sweden. For a public school in the United States, the law of its own state applies. Where this agreement and the general terms differ on personal data, this agreement applies.

## 16. Schools in the United States

LessonCraftStudio acts as a school official with a legitimate educational interest (34 CFR 99.31(a)(1)(i)(B)): it performs a service the School would otherwise perform itself, is under the School's direct control as to the use and keeping of education records, uses them only for the purpose in section 2 and does not disclose them further (34 CFR 99.33(a)). The School authorizes the collection described in section 3 for its educational purpose only, and can review the data, have it deleted and stop further collection at any time. LessonCraftStudio does not use student data for targeted advertising, does not sell it, and builds no profile of a student except for the School's purposes. On request LessonCraftStudio signs the School's or its state's own student data privacy agreement (for example the National Data Privacy Agreement, the New York Parents' Bill of Rights supplement with a data security and privacy plan, or an Illinois SOPPA agreement); first names are switched on for a school in a state that requires such an agreement only after it is signed.

## How a school accepts it

(1) For numbers-only classes these terms apply through the teacher's confirmation when she makes her first class. (2) To switch first names on, a person authorized to sign for the school accepts this agreement on a page of the site that is opened when first names are offered, giving name, role, school, the school's official e-mail address and the confirmation "I am authorized to conclude this agreement for the school named above"; LessonCraftStudio confirms by e-mail to that address and only then switches first names on for the teachers the school names. (3) A countersigned PDF is sent on request. A teacher's confirmation covers numbers-only classes; she cannot accept this agreement for a school.

# A note for parents

> **For the teacher (this block is not part of the note):** Use this note only if your school allows you to use this tool. It informs parents; it does not replace your school's own privacy information. Print or send it; fill in the lines in square brackets. One page, no legal vocabulary.

---

**Dear parents,**

In class we sometimes practice on a screen with worksheets from LessonCraftStudio. I use a class link for this, so that I can see which exercises each child has understood and who needs more practice.

**What your child does.** Your child opens the class page, taps their number and animal picture and does the worksheet. There is no account, no password and nothing to install.

**What is stored.**
- No name: only a number and an animal picture. I keep the list of who has which number myself.
- For each worksheet: which worksheet it was, when it was opened, how many answers were right and which ones, how often the answers were checked, and whether the page was finished.

**What is not stored.** No surname, no date of birth, no photo, no address, no email. The site does not record what your child types, and there is no timer.

**Who sees it.** Only I can see the results. Other parents and other teachers cannot. On the shared class page a child can see which worksheets another seat has finished, but never how many answers were right. Your child sees no scores, no ranking and no timer.

**What it is used for.** Only for my teaching. It is not used for advertising and is not sold. It is stored for [name of school] on a server in Finland by the operator of the site, who may use it only for this.

**How long it is kept.** I can delete your child's results at any time. Each result is deleted automatically after 14 months at the latest[, and at the end of the school year I delete the class].

**Your questions.** If you would like to see what is stored about your child, have it corrected or deleted, or if you do not want your child's results to be stored, please tell me. [Contact.]

[Name of teacher, school, date] · Responsible for this data: [name of school]. More: www.lessoncraftstudio.com/en/privacy#classes
